cases.situation: Got a WhatsApp from my friend Priya's number saying she's stuck abroad, lost her wallet and needs $600 wired today, and please don't tell anyone because it's embarrassing. Doesn't sound like her.
cases.reply: Hey, I just got a message from your WhatsApp asking me to wire $600 today. I'm guessing that wasn't you? Ring me when you can.
cases.note: Money, urgency and secrecy together. Don't reply in the WhatsApp thread; send this by SMS or call her saved number.

cases.situation: 我爸最近总跟我说他在一个'理财群'里跟着'老师'炒股赚了不少，还说老师让他加大投入、别跟家里人说。我很担心，但他很好面子。
cases.reply: 爸，想跟你聊聊那个理财群的事，我保证不是来说教的。那个老师有没有让你往他给的账户里转钱，或者让你别告诉家里人？现在这种骗子都很专业，很多聪明人都被骗过。不管情况怎样，我们一起想办法，我周六回家陪你一起看看。
cases.note: 目标是让他愿意跟你说实话。羞辱会让他把下一个骗局藏起来。

cases.situation: My neighbour Gary (retired, 70s) just told me he clicked a 'Royal Mail' text link yesterday and paid a £1.99 redelivery fee with his card. Now he's worried.
cases.reply: Don't be hard on yourself, Gary, these texts are built to look exactly like the real thing. Call the number on the back of your card right now and tell them what happened, so they can block it before anything else goes through. Then forward the text to 7726 and delete it. I'm home all afternoon if you want me to sit with you while you call.
cases.note: Act first, talk later. Calling the bank fast is what limits the damage.

cases.situation: I do the accounts at a small architecture firm. Got an email that looks like it's from our print supplier Linden Press saying they've changed banks and we should pay their $6,420 invoice to a new account by Thursday. The address looks right but it feels off.
cases.reply: Hi Marcus, we received an email today from what looks like your accounts address, asking us to pay the $6,420 invoice into a new bank account by Thursday. We're holding the payment until we've confirmed it with you by phone, so could you call me on 555 0148 today or tomorrow? If that email didn't come from you, your mailbox may be compromised and it's worth telling your IT people.
cases.note: Send this to the contact details already on file, never to the reply address or number in the suspicious email.

cases.situation: 我姑姑昨天接到一个电话，声音特别像我表弟，说在外地出了车祸要她马上转3万，还不让告诉别人。幸好她打了表弟本人电话。想在家族群里提醒长辈们，但不想让姑姑难堪。
cases.reply: 各位长辈，提醒大家一件事：最近有骗子用AI模仿孩子的声音打电话，说出了车祸或者被派出所扣了，要马上转钱，还叮嘱别告诉家里人。咱们家这两天就接到过一次，好在及时识破了。以后不管声音多像，只要是要钱，先挂掉，再用自己手机里存的号码打回去确认，或者在群里问一声。这种骗局很专业，谁都可能碰上，拿不准就随时打给我。
cases.note: 群里提醒只讲骗局的套路和核实办法，不点名是谁接到的；让长辈觉得遇到了可以说，而不是怕丢面子。

cases.situation: My mom (68) has been chatting for 3 months with a man on Facebook who says he's an engineer on an oil rig. Now he wants $2,500 from her for a 'customs fee' to ship his things. She gets defensive when I bring it up.
cases.reply: Mom, I'm glad you've had someone to talk to, and I'm not trying to take that away. Before any money goes anywhere, can we do one thing together: ask Richard for a live video call, not a photo or a voice note. If he is who he says, that's easy for him. I can come over Saturday and we'll set it up together.
cases.note: Don't say 'scam' to someone emotionally invested; agree on one test the real person would pass and do it with her.
